title: DECISION: did:key-only in v1 (no did:web)
description: v1 supports only did:key DIDs. did:web and all other DID methods return UnsupportedMethod immediately in parse_did_key without any network I/O. This is the correct call because did:web resolution requires an outbound HTTPS fetch to an attacker-controlled hostname embedded in the article header, which is a direct SSRF vector. did:key is self-contained: the public key is encoded in the identifier itself and verification is entirely local. The restriction is explicitly documented in the module-level doc comment and the UnsupportedMethod error variant.
